---
title: "Lecture 16: Recurrent Neural Networks and LSTMs"
---

## Overview

A recurrent model carries a state from one input to the next. We examine how LSTM gates control retention, compare digit models under matched training budgets, and test what happens when a prediction must wait through blank inputs.

## Learning Objectives

- Trace a recurrent state update and explain shared parameters.
- Explain how LSTM gates retain, write, and expose content.
- Interpret gradient and delayed-answer experiments; compare recurrent inference state with an attention KV cache.
